name: state
meaning: 0 idle: counts Ralph + sheep in fallZone every update; 1 creaking (anim 5, one loop per anim end); 2 collapsing (anim 2 until it ends); 3 fallen (anim 4) or dead (no record / no FALLINGZONE). bridge_Init 0x49d327/0x49d33d/0x49d361, bridge_Update 0x49d538/0x49d71d/0x49d7ce/0x49d91b, bridge_Reset 0x49df68/0x49df71

name: fallZone
meaning: FALLINGZONE (Scn_GetPropBox(record, 0), 0x49d347): where Ralph and a sheep together start the creaking (bridge_CountWolfAndSheep 0x49db30) and whose objects get msg 0 arg 1 on the collapse (bridge_Collapse 0x49dd3c). 0 makes the bridge dead (state 3)

name: pushZone
meaning: IDOBJECTSFALLZONE box (first entry of its id list, 0x49d39a), else fallZone (0x49d3b1); bridge_PushObjectsDown moves every object whose origin is in its XZ rectangle 10 units down per update (0x49ddfc)

name: otherPart
meaning: OTHERPART (Scn_GetPropObject(record, 8), 0x49d3e5). Only the half that has one is the master: it freezes Ralph at creak loop 6, starts the snap camera and at loop 12 runs the collapse (0x49d619, 0x49d707). In Lvl-01 the north half (z 3015) has it, the south half not

name: creakLoops
meaning: creak animations finished in state 1: 0 on entering from state 0 (0x49d4dc); 6 = freeze + snap camera, 12 = collapse (0x49d60d, 0x49d6b0)

name: pairDist
meaning: XZ distance Ralph-sheep, (s32)sqrt, written by bridge_CountWolfAndSheep (0x49dcdb); > 300 starts the snap camera (0x49d622, unsigned); raised to 600 by bridge_StartSnapCamera (0x49d9c4) and read there as s16 for the camera distance (0x49d9da)

name: pushDown
meaning: set by bridge_Collapse (0x49ddc5); while set every update calls bridge_PushObjectsDown (0x49d922). Cleared by Init / Reset

name: wolfFrozen
meaning: Ralph's reply to msg 0xE (the freeze) at creak loop 6 (0x49d64e); while set the bridge sends msg 0xF (unfreeze) when the count drops below 2 (0x49d87d) or on the collapse (0x49dcfa), then clears it. Msg 0xE sent TO the bridge clears it too (bridge_HandleMessage 0x49dfa0)

name: snapCamRot
meaning: rotation of the snap camera: (0, bridge facing + 0x400, 0) (bridge_StartSnapCamera 0x49da36-0x49da56); passed as its three u16 arguments

name: snapCamPos
meaning: eye of the snap camera: midpoint + the offset (0, 0, -max(pairDist, 600)) turned by (0, facing + 0x400, 0), 100 higher (0x49da5f-0x49daa5)

name: midpoint
meaning: midpoint of Ralph and the sheep ((a + b) / 2 per axis), written by bridge_CountWolfAndSheep (0x49dc1e-0x49dc5c) when both are in fallZone
